issues.claim: and re-embed everything if the embedding model changes.
issues.problem: No freshness trade-off (latency vs complexity, cost of full re-embed).
issues.replacement: and re-embed everything if the embedding model changes (build the new index alongside the old one and switch over). Trade-off: event-driven updates keep search minutes-fresh but need a queue and idempotent upserts, whereas a nightly batch is simpler but leaves edits unsearchable for up to a day.
